steps.name: research-papers
steps.description: Skipped: prior literature surveys (t0015-t0019, t0027) and references in the task description supply the lit context.

steps.name: research-internet
steps.description: Skipped: task is implementation-focused with explicit specification; no new external knowledge required.

steps.name: research-code
steps.description: Review t0052 (sibling task with same morphology / synapse placement / E mechanism / HH) for direct reuse; identify what swaps for the spatial centripetal-gating inhibition driver.

steps.name: planning
steps.description: Synthesize research-code into plan/plan.md with concrete code design for the centripetal-only inhibition driver and shared infrastructure with t0052.

steps.name: setup-machines
steps.description: Skipped: task runs on local CPU only ($0 budget).

steps.name: implementation
steps.description: Build the minimal_dsgc_spatial_gaba library asset with centripetal-only inhibition driver, run 12 directions x 10 trials x 3 modes (360 trials), produce per-direction plots and metrics, plus the synapse-activation polar plot specific to the spatial mechanism.

steps.name: teardown
steps.description: Skipped: no remote machines were used.

steps.name: creative-thinking
steps.description: Skipped: task design is fully specified; no exploratory analysis needed at this stage.

steps.name: results
steps.description: Write results_summary.md, results_detailed.md, metrics.json (multi-variant), costs.json, remote_machines_used.json; embed all per-direction PNGs and the synapse-activation polar plot.

steps.name: compare-literature
steps.description: Compare model's primary DSI, peak rate, and tuning shape against Park 2014, de Rosenroll 2026, and t0052 scalar-gabaMOD baseline.

steps.name: suggestions
steps.description: Generate follow-up suggestions covering t0052-vs-t0053 cross-comparison, parameter sweeps, and any biophysical refinements identified during implementation.

steps.name: reporting
steps.description: Run all verificators, capture sessions, set status=completed, push branch, open PR, run pre-merge verificator, merge.
